verdict.rationale: Scheduled or recurring jobs are a fair question for an error-monitoring SaaS, but the evidence shows no BugSnag capability to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. The automation it does document is event-triggered, not time-based: automatic error assignment rules and webhook data forwarding fire when an error arrives. A user's script that dumps exceptions endlessly is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
